note: Written from usp_Insights_Dimension_Licence (sql/21_dimension_licence.sql) as deployed. Verified by SourceMapVerificationTests - every query must return exactly what the report's procedure returned. Licences are counted as of today (no report period). A licence is 'lapsed' when its end date has passed and it did not end another way (terminated, rejected, renewed or not applicable). Date-based figures move every day.
setup: DECLARE @UserID INT = {UserID};
DECLARE @CustomerID INT = {CustomerID};
DECLARE @AsOf DATETIME = GETDATE();
-- Step 1. Licences at the locations this user may see (Lic_tbl_LicenseInstance, not deleted).
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#lic') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #lic;
SELECT li.ID AS LicenseId, li.CustomerBranchID AS BranchID, NULLIF(li.LicenseTypeID, -1) AS LicenseTypeID, li.EndDate INTO #lic
FROM Lic_tbl_LicenseInstance li
WHERE li.CustomerID = @CustomerID AND li.IsDeleted = 0
AND li.CustomerBranchID IN (SELECT BranchID FROM dbo.tvfInsightsScopePairs(@UserID, @CustomerID));
-- Step 2. Each licence's latest status (Lic_tbl_LicenseStatusTransaction, newest StatusChangeOn) and whether that
--         status can count as a lapse (status dictionary InsightsEnumPolarity, Semantic = LicenceStatus:
--         terminated / rejected / renewed / not_applicable can not). No status row at all = can lapse.
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#lapse') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #lapse;
WITH ranked AS (SELECT lst.LicenseID, lst.StatusID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lst.LicenseID ORDER BY lst.StatusChangeOn DESC) AS rn
FROM Lic_tbl_LicenseStatusTransaction lst JOIN #lic l ON l.LicenseId = lst.LicenseID),
cls AS (SELECT TRY_CAST(p.RawValue AS INT) AS StatusId,
CASE WHEN p.Meaning IN (N'terminated', N'rejected', N'renewed', N'not_applicable') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS LapseEligible
FROM dbo.InsightsEnumPolarity p JOIN dbo.InsightsDictionaryVersion v ON v.VersionId = p.VersionId AND v.IsCurrent = 1
WHERE p.Semantic = 'LicenceStatus' AND TRY_CAST(p.RawValue AS INT) IS NOT NULL)
SELECT l.LicenseId, c.LapseEligible INTO #lapse
FROM #lic l LEFT JOIN ranked r ON r.LicenseID = l.LicenseId AND r.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN cls c ON c.StatusId = r.StatusID;
-- Keep today's date for the checks below (each check runs on its own).
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#asof') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #asof;
SELECT @AsOf AS AsOf INTO #asof;

checks.name: Licences in the report
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #lic;

checks.name: Licences with a licence type
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #lic WHERE LicenseTypeID IS NOT NULL;

checks.name: Overall lapsed rate (%)
checks.tables: Lapsed licences that have a licence type / ALL licences (typed or not) x 100 - exactly as the procedure does it. Licences with no type (LicenseTypeID -1) count in the bottom number but never as lapsed, so untyped licences pull this rate down.
query: SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0
ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.LicenseTypeID IS NOT NULL AND l.EndDate < a.AsOf AND ISNULL(x.LapseEligible, 1) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) END AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS Value
FROM #lic l JOIN #lapse x ON x.LicenseId = l.LicenseId CROSS JOIN #asof a;

checks.name: Licence types that have licences
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LicenseTypeID) AS Value FROM #lic WHERE LicenseTypeID IS NOT NULL;

checks.name: Licences past end date that ended another way
checks.tables: End date passed and latest status is terminated / rejected / renewed / not applicable.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #lic l JOIN #lapse x ON x.LicenseId = l.LicenseId CROSS JOIN #asof a
WHERE l.EndDate < a.AsOf AND x.LapseEligible = 0 AND l.LicenseTypeID IS NOT NULL;

checks.name: A licence type's licences
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #lic WHERE LicenseTypeID = {RowKey};

checks.name: A licence type's licences still in force
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #lic CROSS JOIN #asof a WHERE LicenseTypeID = {RowKey} AND EndDate >= a.AsOf;

checks.name: A licence type's lapsed licences
checks.tables: End date passed and did not end another way (step 2).
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #lic l JOIN #lapse x ON x.LicenseId = l.LicenseId CROSS JOIN #asof a
WHERE l.LicenseTypeID = {RowKey} AND l.EndDate < a.AsOf AND ISNULL(x.LapseEligible, 1) = 1;

checks.name: A licence type's licences that ended another way
checks.tables: End date passed and latest status is terminated / rejected / renewed / not applicable.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #lic l JOIN #lapse x ON x.LicenseId = l.LicenseId CROSS JOIN #asof a
WHERE l.LicenseTypeID = {RowKey} AND l.EndDate < a.AsOf AND x.LapseEligible = 0;

checks.name: A licence type's licences ending in the next 30 days
checks.tables: End date after today and within 30 days.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Value FROM #lic CROSS JOIN #asof a WHERE LicenseTypeID = {RowKey}
AND EndDate > a.AsOf AND EndDate <= DATEADD(DAY, 30, a.AsOf);

checks.name: Locations holding a licence type
checks.tables: Distinct CustomerBranch of this type's licences.
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BranchID) AS Value FROM #lic WHERE LicenseTypeID = {RowKey};

checks.name: A licence type's lapsed rate (%)
query: SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0
ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.EndDate < a.AsOf AND ISNULL(x.LapseEligible, 1) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) END AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS Value
FROM #lic l JOIN #lapse x ON x.LicenseId = l.LicenseId CROSS JOIN #asof a WHERE l.LicenseTypeID = {RowKey};
